source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 4 May 1933, p. 9 ("Ulster local elections: Belfast and Larne rural councils")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the nine names and divisions read from the News-Letter's Belfast Rural Council nomination list (4 May 1933, p. 9), which states 'There will be no contests, the above being declared elected'

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, one for each of the nine electoral divisions. The nominations were received on 3 May 1933 and, as there were no contests, the nominees were declared elected. Polling in County Antrim took place on 1 June 1933. Bell. Returned unopposed.
